title: BuildDeck nested loops: 4 suits × 13 ranks
requirements: Use exactly four columns in order S,H,D,C and thirteen rows in ascending rank 2…14.
Traverse rank-major order: 2S,2H,2D,2C,3S,…,AC. Never transpose the outer and inner loops.
Show Rank, SuitIndex, Index, and the corresponding grid cell. Index starts at 0; the final occupied index is 51, then Index becomes 52.
Preserve Dim/For/Next spelling in any excerpt; pair colored brackets with text labels, not color alone.
beats: 3–8 s: walk all four suits of rank 2 slowly.
8–14 s: accelerate the middle ranks without skipping recorded states.
14–18 s: show final Ace row and Index=52 completion state.
checks: All 52 unique rank/suit combinations are filled exactly once.
Final cell is Ace of Clubs at index 51.
Next SuitIndex is visibly inner; Next Rank is visibly outer.
The ordered build is not mislabeled as shuffled or dealt.
copy:
For Rank = 2 To 14
For SuitIndex = 0 To 3
52 cards = 13 ranks × 4 suits
